name: Arjun Menon
headline: B.Com graduate · Accounts and GST
summary: Commerce graduate looking for an accounts assistant role. I've done GST filing and Tally entries for two small shops during my internship, and I like work where the numbers have to be exactly right.

details: Final-year project: compared GST filing time for 12 Thrissur shops before and after using Tally Prime.

bullets: Entered about 300 purchase and sales bills a month in Tally Prime for two retail clients.
Prepared GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B drafts for the senior accountant to review; none needed corrections in my last month.
Matched bank statements with ledgers and flagged 14 entries that didn't add up.

projects.name: Expense tracker in Google Sheets
bullets: Made a monthly expense sheet for my family with category totals and a chart; my parents still use it.
